trips.name: Maafushi Madness Maldives - Live Test
trips.tagline: Channel Drifts, Nurse Sharks & Crystal Turquoise Lagoons
trips.summary: Join us on an unforgettable dive expedition to Maafushi, Maldives. Explore thrilling channel dives, nurse shark gatherings, manta ray cleaning stations, and crystal clear waters.
trips.overview: Maafushi Madness is our signature Maldivian ocean expedition designed for passionate divers who crave world-class underwater encounters without compromise. Centered around South Malé Atoll, this journey takes you to iconic channel passes where strong ocean currents bring schools of pelagics, friendly nurse sharks, spotted eagle rays, and gliding manta rays. On land, you'll experience vibrant Maldivian island culture, pristine white sandbanks, and warm ocean camaraderie with your fellow dive buddies.
highlights: Epic Shark Point encounter with dozens of friendly nurse sharks
Gliding with manta rays at active cleaning stations
Kandooma Thila & Cocoa Corner exhilarating channel drift dives
Speedboat safari to secluded sandbanks in crystal turquoise lagoons
Small diver-to-guide ratio (max 4:1) with certified PADI dive masters
Complete logistics handled from the moment you land at Malé airport

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paradise & Island Welcome
itinerary.subtitle: Speedboat Transfer • Sunset Briefing
itinerary.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport (Malé). Our expedition team meets you at the arrivals gate for a private speedboat transfer across turquoise atoll waters to Maafushi Island. Check into your deluxe beachside hotel, unpack your dive gear, and enjoy a sunset welcome orientation over fresh coconuts.

itinerary.title: Check Dive & The Walls of Kandooma
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Coral Channels
itinerary.description: Start the morning with a gentle checkout dive at Maafushi Corner to dial in buoyancy and check weights. After a surface interval with tropical fruits, drop in at Kandooma Thila — one of the top ten dive sites in the Maldives — featuring dramatic coral swim-throughs and schools of giant trevally.

itinerary.title: Nurse Shark Safari & Deep Thila
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Pelagic Action
itinerary.description: Today is the headline shark encounter. Descend onto a sandy plateau where dozens of resident nurse sharks and stingrays gather. Watch these majestic animals cruise effortlessly around you. The second dive explores Guraidhoo Corner, famous for grey reef sharks patrolling the drop-off.

itinerary.title: Manta Ray Cleaning Stations & Drift Dive
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Manta Magic
itinerary.description: Head out to a renowned manta cleaning station. Hover motionless above the reef as giant oceanic and reef manta rays swoop gracefully over coral heads to be cleaned by cleaner wrasse. Afternoon drift dive over kaleidoscopic soft coral fields.

itinerary.title: Final Ocean Dives & Deserted Sandbank Sunset
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Private Sandbank Barbecue
itinerary.description: Complete your final 2 morning dives exploring pristine coral pinnacles packed with anthias, clownfish, and reef octopuses. In the afternoon, board our boat for a trip to a private, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the lagoon. Celebrate an unforgettable trip with a beach sunset dinner.

itinerary.title: Surface Interval & Homeward Journey
itinerary.subtitle: Island Breakfast • Speedboat to Malé
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely tropical breakfast overlooking the ocean. Complete your surface interval, log your dives, and take final island photos. Speedboat transfer back to Malé airport for your homeward flights.

inclusions: 5 Nights deluxe island accommodation in Maafushi
10 guided boat dives with certified PADI Divemasters
Roundtrip airport speedboat transfers (Malé MLE ↔ Maafushi)
Daily breakfast & dive-day lunch / snacks on boat
12L aluminum tanks, weights, belts & Nitrox for certified divers
All Maldivian marine park fees, green tax & service charges
Exclusive Purva Ocean Adventures expedition rashguard & dry bag
High-resolution underwater photos & videos taken by our team
exclusions: International airfare to Velana International Airport (MLE)
Full dive equipment rental (BCD, regulator, wetsuit available for rent)
Mandatory dive travel insurance (DAN, World Nomads or equivalent)
Personal expenses, alcoholic beverages & crew gratuities
requirements: Minimum certification: PADI Open Water Diver (or equivalent)
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Signed standard PADI medical statement prior to departure

pricing.note: Early bird pricing valid until slots fill. Double occupancy. Solo supplement available.

trips.name: Lakshadweep Love
trips.tagline: Untouched Coral Atolls, Sea Turtle Sanctuaries & Pure Isolation
trips.summary: Discover the untouched paradise of Lakshadweep. Dive into crystal clear waters with vibrant sea turtles, pristine coral formations, dramatic drop-offs, and remote tropical atoll adventures.
trips.overview: Lakshadweep Love takes you to India's best-kept marine secret. Far removed from commercial tourist trails, the coral atolls of Lakshadweep boast visibility often exceeding 35 meters, healthy table coral gardens that stretch as far as the eye can see, and a thriving population of resident green sea turtles. With strictly regulated tourism permits, you'll dive reefs that have seen virtually zero human footprint. This trip is designed for curious souls looking for pure nature, peaceful island rhythms, and world-class tropical diving.
highlights: Diving alongside friendly green sea turtles in crystal clear shallows
Untouched coral reef gardens and dramatic outer barrier drop-offs
All restricted entry permits & heritage documentation fully handled
Explore remote atolls with tranquil turquoise lagoons
Small intimate expedition group with personalized coaching

itinerary.title: Flight into Agatti & Arrival in Paradise
itinerary.subtitle: Scenic Atoll Flight • Lagoon Check-In
itinerary.description: Board your flight from Kochi (COK) to Agatti (AGX) — famous as one of the world's most spectacular airstrips surrounded entirely by turquoise sea. Meet your Purva team, complete permit checks, transfer to your seaside resort, and take a sunset swim in the calm lagoon.

itinerary.title: Lagoon Checkout & Turtle Garden
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Coral Shallows
itinerary.description: Ease into the water with a gentle dive inside the protective reef. Meet resident green and hawksbill turtles grazing on sea grass. Dive two explores Coral Garden, where massive brain and staghorn corals teem with clownfish, blue tangs, and butterflyfish.

itinerary.title: The Outer Reef Barrier & Shark Point
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Boat Dives • Deep Visibility
itinerary.description: Head through the channel to the open ocean outer reef wall. Here the depth drops into deep indigo. Marvel at gorgonian sea fans, passing mobula rays, and curious blacktip reef sharks patrolling the outer drop-off in 40-meter crystal visibility.

itinerary.title: Cavern Swim-Throughs & Shipwreck Site
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Boat Dives • Underwater Topography
itinerary.description: Explore underwater arches, cavern swim-throughs, and an ancient reef shipwreck colonized by thousands of glassfish and lionfish. Afternoon surface interval includes traditional island snacks and coconut tree groves walk.

itinerary.title: Final Pinnacle Dives & Sunset Bonfire
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Boat Dives • Beach Barbecue
itinerary.description: Complete your final 2 morning dives on an isolated coral pinnacle where pelagics cruise by in the morning light. Spend the afternoon kayaking the lagoon before gathering around a beachfront barbecue with stargazing under unpolluted skies.

itinerary.title: Morning Farewell & Flight to Kochi
itinerary.subtitle: Breakfast • Airport Transfer
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final sunrise over the turquoise atoll. Transfer to Agatti Airport for your flight back to Kochi, taking with you unforgettable memories of India's purest ocean frontier.

inclusions: 5 Nights beachfront cottage accommodation in Lakshadweep
12 guided boat & lagoon dives with certified PADI dive masters
Complete Lakshadweep entry permit processing & police clearance
All inter-island transfers and boat charters
All daily meals (freshly caught fish, local coastal curries & vegetarian options)
12L tanks, weight belts, and surface marker buoys (SMB)
Complimentary kayak & paddleboard access during free hours
Purva Ocean Adventures expedition pack & dive log stamps
exclusions: Flights to and from Agatti (Kochi ↔ Agatti roundtrip)
Personal scuba equipment rental (BCD, regulator, fins)
requirements: Minimum certification: PADI Open Water Diver (or beginner resort courses available)
Indian or foreign passport required for Lakshadweep entry permit issuance
Permit applications close 25 days before departure date

pricing.note: Permits strictly limited per departure. Bookings close 30 days prior to departure.

trips.name: Maldives Dive Expedition
trips.tagline: The Ultimate Central Atolls Liveaboard & Pelagic Safari
trips.summary: A signature ocean journey through world-famous Maldivian reefs and deep channels. Encounter whale sharks, eagle rays, and night dives with hunting nurse sharks in paradise.
trips.overview: Living aboard a dedicated safari yacht is the gold standard of scuba diving. Our February 2027 Maldives Expedition navigates the iconic Central Atolls route: North Malé, South Malé, Vaavu, and Ari Atolls. By moving with the currents, we dive the best thilas and kandus (ocean passes) at the optimal times of day. Wake up to sunrise over a new coral reef, step straight onto our dedicated dive dhoni, and encounter pelagic giants: whale sharks cruising along the reef edge, manta rays hovering at cleaning stations, and dramatic night dives surrounded by dozens of feeding nurse sharks.
highlights: Dedicated search for gentle giant Whale Sharks in South Ari
Legendary Alimatha night dive surrounded by massive nurse sharks
World-class channel drift diving with reef sharks and eagle ray squadrons
Living aboard a spacious luxury safari yacht with chef-prepared meals
Up to 17 dives over 6 days including spectacular sunset & night dives
Nitrox available onboard for certified enriched air divers

itinerary.title: Embarkation on Luxury Safari Yacht
itinerary.subtitle: Airport Dhoni Pickup • Welcome Dinner
itinerary.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport (Malé). Step onto our private dive dhoni and cruise out to our luxury liveaboard safari vessel anchored in the lagoon. Meet your expedition leaders, captain, and dive crew. Checkout dive at a protected nearby reef followed by a sunset welcome dinner on the upper deck.

itinerary.title: North Malé Channels & Lankan Manta Point
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Dives • Manta Ray Cleaning Stations
itinerary.description: Wake up to early morning coffee as we set course for Lankan Manta Point. Watch majestic manta rays circle massive coral heads. Dive two and three take you to thrilling coral passes where grey reef sharks patrol against incoming oceanic currents.

itinerary.title: South Ari Whale Shark Quest
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Dives • The Ocean's Gentle Giants
itinerary.description: Cruise south into Ari Atoll, world-famous for year-round whale shark sightings. Our crew keeps watch from the top deck. When a whale shark is spotted, slip into the azure water for an awe-inspiring snorkel and dive alongside the largest fish in the world.

itinerary.title: Maaya Thila & The Alimatha Night Frenzy
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Dives + 1 Night Dive • Epic Shark Action
itinerary.description: Dive the renowned Maaya Thila marine sanctuary, packed with sleeping leopard sharks, morays, and turtles. As night falls, we drop onto Alimatha Jetty: an exhilarating night dive where dozens of 3-meter nurse sharks and giant stingrays swim right between your bubbles.

itinerary.title: Vaavu Atoll Golden Wall & Deserted Sandbank
itinerary.subtitle: 3 Dives • Coral Overhangs & Beach BBQ
itinerary.description: Drift along Golden Wall, a vertical drop-off covered entirely in brilliant yellow soft corals. In the evening, the crew prepares a candlelit sandbank barbecue carved out of sand on a deserted island under the stars.

itinerary.title: Banana Reef & Sunset Cruise to Malé
itinerary.subtitle: 2 Dives • Celebratory Night
itinerary.description: Final morning dives at Banana Reef — the first dive site discovered in the Maldives. Enjoy lunch as the yacht cruises back toward Malé harbor. Celebrate the week with an awards night and farewell banquet.

itinerary.title: Disembarkation & Homeward Flights
itinerary.subtitle: Breakfast • Airport Transfer
itinerary.description: Breakfast on the sun deck, group photos, and transfer by dive dhoni back to Velana International Airport for your international departure flights.

Up to 17 guided boat dives with experienced PADI Cruise Directors

Dedicated dive dhoni equipped with compressor, oxygen & emergency kits
12L aluminum tanks, weights, belts & Nitrox for certified divers

courses.name: Open Water Diver
courses.tagline: Your Lifetime Passport to Underwater Exploration
courses.certification: PADI Open Water Diver (Lifetime International Certification)
courses.prerequisites: Basic swimming skills (200m swim & 10min tread), med clearance
courses.summary: Become a fully certified scuba diver with the world's most recognized and respected diving credential. Breathe underwater, explore vibrant coral reefs, and dive independently with a buddy anywhere across the globe.
courses.overview: The PADI Open Water Diver course is the world's most popular and widely recognized scuba qualification. Millions of people have learned to scuba dive through this course, embarking on a lifelong journey of ocean discovery. Under the direct guidance of certified Purva Ocean Adventures instructors, you will learn the essential principles and skills needed to explore the underwater realm safely and with complete confidence.
skillsLearned: Breathing comfortably underwater & mastering neutral buoyancy control
Essential safety techniques: mask clearing, regulator recovery & out-of-air scenarios
Dive equipment assembly, pre-dive safety buddy checks & gear maintenance
Underwater navigation basics, dive computer reading & dive planning
Marine life appreciation and ocean conservation etiquette

phases.title: Knowledge Development (PADI eLearning)
phases.description: Learn the basic principles and safety concepts of scuba diving at your own pace from home or on the beach via your phone or tablet.

phases.title: Confined Water Dives (Pool Training)
phases.description: Practice essential scuba skills in a calm pool or pool-like environment until you feel completely natural and relaxed underwater.

phases.title: Open Water Dives (4 Ocean Dives)
phases.description: Put your skills into practice on real coral reefs! Experience 4 boat or shore ocean dives exploring stunning marine life with your instructor.

inclusions: PADI Official Digital eLearning Materials & Lifetime Certification Card
Full Scuba Gear Rental (BCD, regulator, wetsuit, mask, snorkel, fins & weights)
Dedicated Certified PADI Instructor (small student-to-instructor ratio)
Logbook & Digital Certification Processing Fees
Marine Sanctuary & Boat Access Fees
requirements: Ability to swim 200 meters continuously without aids
Ability to float / tread water for 10 minutes
Completed PADI Medical Questionnaire (doctor sign-off if required)

pricing.note: Includes gear, boat dives, certification fees & e-Learning

courses.name: Advanced Open Water Diver
courses.tagline: Expand Your Limits, Deepen Your Skills & Adventure Further
courses.certification: PADI Advanced Open Water Diver (Up to 30 Meters / 100 Feet)
courses.prerequisites: PADI Open Water Diver (or qualifying certification from another agency)
courses.summary: Take your diving skills to the next level. Complete 5 specialized Adventure Dives, including Deep Diving (down to 30m) and Underwater Navigation, plus exciting electives like Drift, Wreck, and Night diving.
courses.overview: The Advanced Open Water Diver course isn't about being 'expert'—it's designed to advance your diving skills right after your Open Water course. You'll build confidence and expand your scuba capabilities through 5 distinct Adventure Dives. You'll try different specialties under the supervision of your Purva Ocean Adventures instructor, gaining valuable experience, discovering new dive activities, and opening up world-famous deep reef and wreck dive sites worldwide.
skillsLearned: Deep diving techniques, gas management & dealing with physiological effects down to 30m
Precision underwater compass navigation, kick-cycle pacing & natural topography tracking
Peak Performance Buoyancy: streamlining, effortless trim & reduced air consumption
Choice of 3 Adventure electives: Drift diving, Wreck diving, Night diving, Fish ID or Photography
Handling unexpected currents, safety stop deployments & delayed surface marker buoys (DSMB)

phases.title: Deep Adventure Dive (Required)
phases.description: Descend safely past 18 meters down to 30 meters. Experience the deep marine environment, color changes, and buoyancy adjustments.

phases.title: Underwater Navigation Dive (Required)
phases.description: Master compass navigation, kick-cycles, and natural landmarks to effortlessly find your way back to the boat or exit point.

phases.title: 3 Adventure Elective Dives
phases.description: Customize your training: soar with ocean currents on a Drift dive, explore historic shipwrecks, or witness nocturnal critters on a Night dive.

inclusions: PADI Advanced Open Water Digital eLearning Materials
5 Guided Adventure Ocean Boat Dives with Certified Instructor
Specialty Equipment Rentals (Compass, dive computer, underwater lights, DSMB)
PADI Advanced Certification Card (qualifies you to 30m worldwide)
Small Group Guarantee (Maximum 4 divers per instructor)
requirements: PADI Open Water Diver certification (or equivalent from another training agency)

pricing.note: Includes all specialty gear, boat excursions & digital materials

courses.name: Specialty Diver Certifications
courses.tagline: Master Niche Disciplines: Nitrox, Deep 40m, Wrecks & Photography
courses.prerequisites: PADI Open Water or Advanced Open Water Diver
courses.summary: Specialize in what fascinates you most. From Enriched Air Nitrox (stay underwater longer) to Deep Diver (40m limit), Wreck Diver, and Underwater Photography—hone your skills with master-level credentials.
courses.overview: Whether you want to spend more time exploring pristine reefs using Enriched Air Nitrox, explore sunken historic shipwrecks safely, or reach the recreational limit of 40 meters, PADI Specialty Courses give you dedicated, in-depth expertise. Taught by seasoned Purva Ocean Adventures specialists, these courses empower you with specialized equipment mastery, emergency protocols, and elite underwater awareness.
skillsLearned: Enriched Air Nitrox (EANx): analyze oxygen mixtures (up to 40% O2) & safely extend no-decompression limits
Deep Diver: plan, manage air consumption & dive safely down to 40 meters / 130 feet
Wreck Diver: navigate shipwreck exteriors, mapping, hazard avoidance & penetration line protocols
Underwater Photography: composition, manual strobe lighting & capturing crisp marine life shots
Emergency Oxygen Provider & Surface Marker Buoy (DSMB) specialty techniques

phases.title: Hands-on Workshop & Pre-dive Planning
phases.description: Calibrate oxygen analyzers, rig reels and lines, adjust strobe angles, or configure redundant deep breathing systems.

phases.title: Specialty Ocean Execution Dives

inclusions: PADI Specialty eLearning Materials & Lifetime Brevet Certification
Dedicated Specialty Equipment (Oxygen analyzers, deep dive computers, reels, lights)
High-Nitrox Gas Fills & Double Cylinders where applicable
Boat Charters to specialized deep/wreck dive sites
PADI Specialty Instructor Mentorship & Personalized Skill Coaching

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to swim to go scuba diving?
faqs.answer: For PADI Open Water certification, you need to meet basic swimming and floating requirements. However, certain supervised introductory scuba experiences may be available for non-swimmers, depending on the dive centre and programme.

faqs.question: Can I join a dive trip without being certified?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our expeditions welcome both beginners and certified divers, depending on the trip. You can begin your scuba journey with a PADI Open Water course or join us for recreational dives if you're already certified.

faqs.question: Is scuba diving safe for beginners?
faqs.answer: Scuba diving is an adventure that requires proper training and safety precautions. We work with qualified dive professionals and prioritise appropriate equipment, safety procedures, and personalised guidance throughout your experience.

faqs.question: What if I'm nervous about diving underwater?
faqs.answer: That's completely normal! Many divers feel nervous before their first dive. Your instructor will guide you through the equipment, breathing techniques, and essential skills, allowing you to progress at a comfortable pace.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Open Water and Advanced Open Water certification?
faqs.answer: PADI Open Water Diver is your first certification, teaching you essential diving skills and qualifying eligible adults to dive up to 18 metres. PADI Advanced Open Water Diver builds your confidence and experience through different adventure dives, including deeper diving, with a maximum training depth of 30 metres for eligible adults.

faqs.question: Will I get to see sharks, manta rays, or turtles?
faqs.answer: The ocean is full of surprises! Depending on the destination and diving conditions, you may encounter reef sharks, manta rays, turtles, colourful fish, and incredible coral reefs. Wildlife encounters are never guaranteed, but that's part of what makes every dive special.

faqs.question: Can I join as a solo traveller?
faqs.answer: Of course! Some of the best ocean friendships begin with strangers. Our small-group expeditions are designed to bring together solo travellers, couples, friends, and ocean lovers who share a passion for adventure. Come solo, leave with stories and new friendships.

faqs.question: How many people are there in each expedition?
faqs.answer: We believe in quality experiences over large crowds. Our current Maafushi, Maldives expedition is limited to a maximum of 10 participants, allowing for a more personal, comfortable, and connected group experience.

faqs.question: Is scuba diving equipment included in the package?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our current Maldives diving packages include essential equipment such as a BCD, regulator, mask, fins, wetsuit, tanks, and weights. Certain additional equipment, including dive computers, may be available at an extra rental cost. Exact inclusions are mentioned in each expedition brochure.

faqs.question: Do I need scuba diving insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Appropriate scuba diving insurance is mandatory for our current Maldives expedition. We recommend choosing coverage that includes diving-related medical emergencies and evacuation, appropriate to your planned diving activities.

faqs.question: How long should I wait before flying after scuba diving?
faqs.answer: For recreational no-decompression diving, common guidance recommends waiting at least 12 hours after a single dive and at least 18 hours after multiple dives or multiple days of diving. Longer intervals may be advisable depending on your dive profile. Our itineraries are planned with appropriate time between the final dive and departure.

faqs.question: How can I book an expedition with Purva Ocean Adventures?
faqs.answer: It's simple! Explore our upcoming expeditions, choose the experience that suits you, and reach out through WhatsApp or our website enquiry form. We'll guide you through package details, availability, booking requirements, and everything you need to prepare for your ocean adventure.
